object: Poseidon-r1/r2 GCC IRA spill sensitivity to compiler flags
question: Does a nearby compiler flag set remove the register-spill issue without changing the source?
number: All four tested flag sets compile for both r1 and r2, but every variant retains allocator spill records; r1/r2 O2 changes the distribution rather than eliminating spills. No variant has a KAT or charged ledger, so no score credit is available.
held_fixed: WSL GCC 15.2.0 and current source; only optimization flags varied
notes: Compiler-local exploratory matrix; no production rebuild, KAT, memory/primitive ledger, package/stage/filing/submission.
reopen_if: A chosen flag set receives a source-identical KAT, exact charged ledger, and organizer target acceptance.
